notes.title: Its demo only took me 10 minutes, but this claymation picture book puzzle game inspired by medieval alchemy is one to watch out for
notes.content: ll Living Things is one of those games I had to check out based on its look alone. It's an interactive alchemical picture book with claymation art, and its demo has me looking forward to the full version of this short, experimental mood piece... Read more.

notes.title: Mouse Fix!
notes.content:
[p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]the elusive mouse offset bug has been caught!
We had previously released a hotfix for the reported mouse offset bug (which, in case we missed an edge case, is still available, and will remain so until stability has been proven) that allowed players to switch between dynamic and static mouse by pressing M.

Today, however, we have released a proper fix! Mouse offset should not haunt you anymore, regardless of monitor setup.[/p][p]Thank you all who reported the bug, and we hope you will enjoy (re)playing the demo, unbothered by mouse ghosts.

Sincere apologies for letting the bug slip through in the first place.[/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards and good fun,

MOXO Team.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619550/aad786ef355a12948c29b3ee9992b1ab1f96a7b8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Mouse Update - hotfix
notes.content:
[p]Dear players, [/p][p][/p][p]A bug regarding offset between mouse sprite and it's true position has been reported by some players earlier today. We are working on a proper update to fix the issue.

In the meantime, we have addressed the issue by releasing a fix - the ability to disable the dynamic mouse. By pressing the letter M at any point during the game, you can switch between dynamic and static mouse.[/p][p][/p][p]The new static mouse does not have all of the functionalities of the dynamic mouse, mainly lacking in loading/clicking animations. However, the hover is functional, and its purpose to hint at clickable elements persists. [/p][p]Thank you all for your feedback, and we hope to see you soon in the patch notes once we fix the issue fully. [/p][p][/p][p]Kind regards,[/p][p]MOXO Team[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45619550/aad786ef355a12948c29b3ee9992b1ab1f96a7b8.png"][/img][/p]
